description: This file defines React components related to an OTP (One-Time Password) input UI, including input slots, grouping, and separators.

methods.name: InputOTP
methods.description: A React component wrapping the OTPInput component with additional styling and props.

methods.name: InputOTPGroup
methods.description: A React component that renders a container div for grouping OTP input slots.

methods.name: InputOTPSlot
methods.description: A React component representing an individual OTP input slot, utilizing context for state.

methods.name: InputOTPSeparator
methods.description: A React component rendering a separator with an icon, used between OTP inputs.
